newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Bodies of seven slain farmers found in Honduras.
newsitem.headline: Bodies of seven slain farmers found in Honduras.

text.p: Remains of seven missing farmers, probably executed by criminals, have been found in western Honduras, officials said on Tuesday.
The bodies, with bullet wounds in the heads and partly eaten by vultures, were found on the banks of the Higuito river near Coloaca, 130 miles (210 km) west of the capital Tegucigalpa.

Eight local farmers went missing on March 23 after leaving nearby La Union to sell beans and buy coffee, family members have said. Authorities said they believed the eighth man was also killed and was dragged away by the river.
"In the coming hours we will contact the families and have them come here to identify the bodies," prosecutor Jose Cruz said.
Gangs of criminals often roam the remote region, preying on farmers who sell their wares in nearby villages, he added.
